messages:
molly: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — auth provider circuit we saw yesterday. I want to capture owners/timelines for the remaining actions and call out any recurring pattern we should monitor.
ashley: +1. I created PM-8421 for the full runbook redo, linking notes from the postmortem.
jordan: I can take the fallback routing work (make model-registry auth tolerant to provider flakiness). ETA: 2 weeks (w/c 2032-05-06). @molly will that timeline work for product?
molly: That works; add a canary test in staging before we promote.
lee: I’ll own the short-term mitigation: extend local token TTL cache and add a circuit-open metric for auth provider 2.0. Target: 72h patch, then monitor.
natalie: Security note: if we increase TTL we need to rotate affected service tokens and update KMS policy docs. I'll coordinate with infra.
sam: From a product POV we need explicit user-facing retry/backoff semantics documented. I'll draft the changelog blurb and customer-facing postmortem.
ashley: Action list I have so far (PM-8421):
- jordan: implement model-registry auth fallback (2w)
- lee: TTL cache + circuit metric (72h)
- natalie: token rotation + KMS update (3d after lee's change)
- molly/sam: customer comms and staged rollout (meets after dev canary)
- ashley: runbook rewrite + test suite expansion (3w)
ops-bot: New ticket created: PM-8421 by ashley.
molly: Can we add a recurring detection rule for auth provider flaps — lookback on 5xx spikes across regions? If infra can alert before 5% of requests fail for >5m it would help.
lee: Yes, I’ll add a Datadog monitor: auth.provider.5xx_rate > 0.05 for 5m, and a composite alert if model-registry auth failures + cloud provider health degrade.
jordan: Also adding a fallback policy to router: on auth failures use cached bearer for up to 30s while we retry async to provider. That should reduce end-user latency spikes.
natalie: Noted. For token rotation sequencing: we should not overlap old/new beyond 10m to avoid cache thundering.
molly: Good call. Let's sync Wednesday 09:30PT to confirm owners and release windows.
sam: I'll invite support + account managers for comms alignment.
ashley: Putting ownership matrix into PM-8421 now. Please add any constraints in-thread.
lee: Quick status: added the monitor draft and a playbook snippet (will push PR in 4h).
jordan: Started a branch for fallback routing. rough patch in the PR by EOD.
molly: Thanks everyone. We'll mark this thread for the postmortem follow-up audit next Friday. If anything slips, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder set: postmortem follow-up audit in 7 days (PM-8421).
